title: The driver recipe's documented ccx ready-needle '⏎ send' no longer exists in the build — the composer hint row has been removed
claude: n/a — claude has never had a composer hint row; its footer is the mode row alone
ccx: the wait burns its full timeout. The composer hint row that sweep #1 quoted ('⏎ send · \⏎ for newline · @ files · / commands · ! bash · ⇧Tab mode') is gone; the only footer is '⏸ manual mode on · ? for shortcuts' (frames-s2qa1/01-ccx-fresh-launch.txt). Dropping the row is arguably parity-positive, but docs/parity/qa-driver.md §2.1 and fragile-spot 4 still name '⏎ send' as THE ccx ready needle, so every agent following the recipe literally eats a 40s stall per launch. '⏸ manual mode on' or '? for shortcuts' works. Filed as a question because I cannot tell whether the hint-row removal was a deliberate wave-C decision.
